gates.evidence: Inspected GpuState owns one Instance/Surface/Device/Queue generation; executed Windows traces use that pair for egui and all active WorldViews.
Executed returned-texture composition uses a fixed world-render then egui-render order; content-addressed screenshots and raw traces exist for all six matrix cases.
Executed v2 matrix cases contain 2100 frames with viewport_count=2 and screenshots of both simultaneous textures.
Executed v1/v2 screenshots visibly contain yellow compositor crosshairs above returned viewport textures.
Executed matrix picks match 101/102 for viewport one and 201/202 for viewport two where active.
100/150/200 deterministic egui scale overrides executed, but no live native window resize sequence was performed; combined gate remains NotRun.
Prior forced invalidation reconstructed generation 1 to 2 and resumed, but the registered device-loss callback was not observed.
Resizable panels execute, but docking, detachment, and persisted layout are absent from this candidate harness.
Every matrix run declares 100000 logical rows while final frames construct only 15-35 visible rows.
Keyboard handlers and accessible buttons exist, but no native end-to-end keyboard traversal transcript was captured.
Selection styling exists, but no native focus-order/visibility observation was captured.
AccessKit initial tree/action/deactivation routing compiles; no UIA tree inspection or Narrator transcript covers controls, state, progress, and errors.
Windows common-controls rfd path compiles, but the dialog was not opened and operated in recorded evidence.
No contrast ratios or reviewed essential-control/text measurements were recorded.
Executed exact tests prove frame progression freezes automatic camera angle when reduced motion is set while explicit orbit input still changes it.
The harness has keyboard-addressable controls but does not implement or record every M1 flow without a mouse.
Executed 1024x768 Windows screenshots show catalog, controls, status, and one/two viewports without clipping at the 100-percent case.
No real project-open operation or content-addressed fixture is in this disposable harness.
No accepted M0 default fixture/budget artifact was available and no real project was opened.
No native scripted input latency samples were captured; frame time is not substituted for input latency.
No diagnostic engine or diagnostic event trace exists in this harness.
No cancellable project operation exists in this harness.
Warm one/two-viewport memory samples exist at all scale overrides with machine/display/power metadata, but cold-cache runs and accepted M0 fixtures/memory budgets are absent.
All six frozen-identity warm release cases completed 300 warmup plus 1800 measured frames, but p95 frame time was 50.25-50.30 ms, exceeding the inherited 16.67 ms gate; cold runs are also absent.
Rust 1.85 rcce-render suite passed 10/10 and production renderer source was not changed.
No unchanged-client screenshot baseline/current hash comparison was run.
Each viewport has separate yaw state and accessible orbit controls with exact state tests, but native independent input was not automated.

All retained cases bind the same executable-source, Cargo.lock, and trace hashes through environment, summary, memory summary, screenshot sidecar, and per-run provenance; the aggregate binds reviewed gates and machine/display/power evidence, but cold-cache runs, accepted fixture hashes, and the accepted M0 artifact are missing.
Wayland/llvmpipe wrote ten frames then terminated with exit 139 after EGL/ZINK errors; X11 remains blocked by missing libxkbcommon-x11.so.
